)

const (
	teacherOnboardingStudentID  = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	teacherOnboardingToken      = "teacher-onboarding-token"
	teacherOnboardingRequestID  = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
	teacherOnboardingFinalizeID = "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
)

type teacherOnboardingClock struct{ now time.Time }

func (clock teacherOnboardingClock) Now() time.Time { return clock.now }

type teacherOnboardingRepositoryStub struct {
	draft             domain.StudentOnboardingDraft
	profile           domain.StudentOnboarding
	profileErr        error
	finalized         domain.StudentOnboardingFinalizeResult
	replaceErr        error
	finalizeErr       error
	draftStudentIDs   []string
	profileStudentIDs []string
	replaceCommands   []repository.StudentOnboardingDraftReplaceCommand
	finalizeCommands  []repository.StudentOnboardingDraftFinalizeCommand
}

func (stub *teacherOnboardingRepositoryStub) GetDraft(_ context.Context, studentID string) (domain.StudentOnboardingDraft, error) {
	stub.draftStudentIDs = append(stub.draftStudentIDs, studentID)
	return stub.draft, nil
}

func (stub *teacherOnboardingRepositoryStub) ReplaceDraft(
	_ context.Context,
	command repository.StudentOnboardingDraftReplaceCommand,
) (domain.StudentOnboardingDraft, bool, error) {
	stub.replaceCommands = append(stub.replaceCommands, command)
	return stub.draft, len(stub.replaceCommands) > 1, stub.replaceErr
}

func (stub *teacherOnboardingRepositoryStub) FinalizeDraft(
	_ context.Context,
	command repository.StudentOnboardingDraftFinalizeCommand,
) (domain.StudentOnboardingFinalizeResult, bool, error) {
	stub.finalizeCommands = append(stub.finalizeCommands, command)
	return stub.finalized, len(stub.finalizeCommands) > 1, stub.finalizeErr
}

func (stub *teacherOnboardingRepositoryStub) Get(_ context.Context, studentID string) (domain.StudentOnboarding, error) {
	stub.profileStudentIDs = append(stub.profileStudentIDs, studentID)
	return stub.profile, stub.profileErr
}

func (stub *teacherOnboardingRepositoryStub) Save(
	context.Context,
	domain.StudentOnboarding,
	int64,
) (domain.StudentOnboarding, error) {
	return domain.StudentOnboarding{}, errors.New("unexpected profile write")
}

func TestTeacherOnboardingGETUsesExactPathAndReturnsAllowlistedState(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 4, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	repo := teacherOnboardingRepository(t, now)
	handler := teacherOnboardingInternalHandler(repo, now)
	router := NewRouter(handler, "general-token", "planner-token", teacherOnboardingToken)
	path := "/v1/teacher/students/" + teacherOnboardingStudentID + "/onboarding/draft"

	response := performTeacherOnboardingRequest(router, http.MethodGet, path, "", "", teacherOnboardingToken)
	if response.Code != http.StatusOK || response.Header().Get("Cache-Control") != "no-store" ||
		len(repo.draftStudentIDs) != 1 || repo.draftStudentIDs[0] != teacherOnboardingStudentID ||
		len(repo.profileStudentIDs) != 1 || repo.profileStudentIDs[0] != teacherOnboardingStudentID {
		t.Fatalf("GET was not bound to the exact path student: status=%d draft_ids=%v profile_ids=%v body=%s",
			response.Code, repo.draftStudentIDs, repo.profileStudentIDs, response.Body.String())
	}
	var state domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingState
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(response.Body.Bytes()))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(&state); err != nil || state.Schema != domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingStateSchema ||
		state.Draft.Schema != domain.StudentOnboardingDraftSchema || state.ProfileVersion != repo.profile.Version {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected strict state: state=%+v err=%v body=%s", state, err, response.Body.String())
	}
	var root map[string]json.RawMessage
	if err := json.Unmarshal(response.Body.Bytes(), &root); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(root) != 3 || root["schema"] == nil || root["draft"] == nil || root["profile_version"] == nil {
		t.Fatalf("response root is not allowlisted: %v", root)
	}
	for _, forbidden := range []string{"request_hash", "receipt", "audit", "mastery", "learning_path", "diagnostic", "raw_evidence"} {
		if strings.Contains(response.Body.String(), forbidden) {
			t.Fatalf("Teacher onboarding state leaked %q: %s", forbidden, response.Body.String())
		}
	}
	repo.profileErr = domain.ErrNotFound
	absentProfile := performTeacherOnboardingRequest(router, http.MethodGet, path, "", "", teacherOnboardingToken)
	if absentProfile.Code != http.StatusOK || !strings.Contains(absentProfile.Body.String(), `"profile_version":0`) {
		t.Fatalf("absent profile did not expose authoritative create precondition: status=%d body=%s",
			absentProfile.Code, absentProfile.Body.String())
	}

	invalid := performTeacherOnboardingRequest(router, http.MethodGet,
		"/v1/teacher/students/not-a-uuid/onboarding/draft", "", "", teacherOnboardingToken)
	if invalid.Code != http.StatusBadRequest || len(repo.draftStudentIDs) != 2 || len(repo.profileStudentIDs) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("invalid path reached repositories: status=%d draft_ids=%v profile_ids=%v",
			invalid.Code, repo.draftStudentIDs, repo.profileStudentIDs)
	}
}

func TestTeacherOnboardingCommandsMatchPublicTransportAndDelegateReplayConflict(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 4, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	repo := teacherOnboardingRepository(t, now)
	internalHandler := teacherOnboardingInternalHandler(repo, now)
	internalRouter := NewRouter(internalHandler, "general-token", "planner-token", teacherOnboardingToken)
	publicRouter := publicOnboardingDraftRouter(repo, now)
	putBody := `{"schema":"student-onboarding-draft.v1","expected_version":1,"goal_text":"","known_stacks":[]}`
	internalPath := "/v1/teacher/students/" + teacherOnboardingStudentID + "/onboarding/draft"

	internalPut := performTeacherOnboardingRequest(internalRouter, http.MethodPut, internalPath, putBody, teacherOnboardingRequestID, teacherOnboardingToken)
	publicPut := performPublicOnboardingRequest(publicRouter, http.MethodPut, "/student/onboarding/draft", putBody, teacherOnboardingRequestID)
	if internalPut.Code != http.StatusOK || publicPut.Code != http.StatusOK || internalPut.Body.String() != publicPut.Body.String() ||
		len(repo.replaceCommands) != 2 || !reflect.DeepEqual(repo.replaceCommands[0], repo.replaceCommands[1]) ||
		repo.replaceCommands[0].StudentID != teacherOnboardingStudentID || repo.replaceCommands[0].ExpectedVersion != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("public/internal PUT diverged: internal=%d %s public=%d %s commands=%+v",
			internalPut.Code, internalPut.Body.String(), publicPut.Code, publicPut.Body.String(), repo.replaceCommands)
	}

	finalizeBody := `{"schema":"student-onboarding-finalize.v1","expected_draft_version":1,"expected_profile_version":1}`
	finalizePath := internalPath + "/finalize"
	internalFinalize := performTeacherOnboardingRequest(internalRouter, http.MethodPost, finalizePath, finalizeBody, teacherOnboardingFinalizeID, teacherOnboardingToken)
	publicFinalize := performPublicOnboardingRequest(publicRouter, http.MethodPost, "/student/onboarding/draft/finalize", finalizeBody, teacherOnboardingFinalizeID)
	if internalFinalize.Code != http.StatusOK || publicFinalize.Code != http.StatusOK ||
		internalFinalize.Body.String() != publicFinalize.Body.String() || len(repo.finalizeCommands) != 2 ||
		!reflect.DeepEqual(repo.finalizeCommands[0], repo.finalizeCommands[1]) ||
		repo.finalizeCommands[0].ExpectedDraftVersion != 1 || repo.finalizeCommands[0].ExpectedProfileVersion != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("public/internal finalize diverged: internal=%d %s public=%d %s commands=%+v",
			internalFinalize.Code, internalFinalize.Body.String(), publicFinalize.Code, publicFinalize.Body.String(), repo.finalizeCommands)
	}

	replay := performTeacherOnboardingRequest(internalRouter, http.MethodPost, finalizePath, finalizeBody, teacherOnboardingFinalizeID, teacherOnboardingToken)
	if replay.Code != http.StatusOK || replay.Body.String() != internalFinalize.Body.String() ||
		len(repo.finalizeCommands) != 3 || repo.finalizeCommands[2].RequestHash != repo.finalizeCommands[0].RequestHash {
		t.Fatalf("finalize replay was not delegated unchanged: status=%d commands=%+v body=%s",
			replay.Code, repo.finalizeCommands, replay.Body.String())
	}
	repo.finalizeErr = domain.ErrConflict
	conflict := performTeacherOnboardingRequest(internalRouter, http.MethodPost, finalizePath, finalizeBody,
		"44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", teacherOnboardingToken)
	if conflict.Code != http.StatusConflict {
		t.Fatalf("use-case conflict was not preserved: status=%d body=%s", conflict.Code, conflict.Body.String())
	}
}

func TestTeacherOnboardingRejectsTokensMalformedUnknownTrailingAndOversize(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 4, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	repo := teacherOnboardingRepository(t, now)
	handler := teacherOnboardingInternalHandler(repo, now)
	router := NewRouter(handler, "general-token", "planner-token", teacherOnboardingToken)
	path := "/v1/teacher/students/" + teacherOnboardingStudentID + "/onboarding/draft"

	var unauthorizedBodies []string
	for _, headers := range []struct {
		name      string
		token     string
		browserID string
	}{
		{name: "missing"},
		{name: "wrong", token: "wrong-token"},
		{name: "general", token: "general-token"},
		{name: "planner", token: "planner-token"},
		{name: "browser only", browserID: teacherOnboardingStudentID},
	} {
		t.Run(headers.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, path, nil)
			request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", headers.token)
			if headers.browserID != "" {
				request.Header.Set("X-User-ID", headers.browserID)
				request.Header.Set("X-User-Role", "TEACHER")
			}
			response := httptest.NewRecorder()
			router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
			if response.Code != http.StatusForbidden {
				t.Fatalf("status=%d body=%s", response.Code, response.Body.String())
			}
			unauthorizedBodies = append(unauthorizedBodies, response.Body.String())
		})
	}
	for _, body := range unauthorizedBodies[1:] {
		if body != unauthorizedBodies[0] {
			t.Fatalf("missing/wrong token responses differ: %q versus %q", unauthorizedBodies[0], body)
		}
	}
	if len(repo.draftStudentIDs) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("unauthorized requests reached use case: %v", repo.draftStudentIDs)
	}

	validPut := `{"schema":"student-onboarding-draft.v1","expected_version":1}`
	tests := []struct {
		name, method, target, body, requestID string
	}{
		{name: "malformed", method: http.MethodPut, target: path, body: `{`, requestID: teacherOnboardingRequestID},
		{name: "unknown", method: http.MethodPut, target: path, body: `{"schema":"student-onboarding-draft.v1","expected_version":1,"student_id":"` + teacherOnboardingStudentID + `"}`, requestID: teacherOnboardingRequestID},
		{name: "trailing", method: http.MethodPut, target: path, body: validPut + `{}`, requestID: teacherOnboardingRequestID},
		{name: "oversize put", method: http.MethodPut, target: path, body: `{"schema":"student-onboarding-draft.v1","expected_version":1,"goal_text":"` + strings.Repeat("x", 17<<10) + `"}`, requestID: teacherOnboardingRequestID},
		{name: "missing idempotency", method: http.MethodPut, target: path, body: validPut},
		{name: "unknown finalize", method: http.MethodPost, target: path + "/finalize", body: `{"schema":"student-onboarding-finalize.v1","expected_draft_version":1,"expected_profile_version":1,"extra":true}`, requestID: teacherOnboardingRequestID},
		{name: "oversize finalize", method: http.MethodPost, target: path + "/finalize", body: `{"schema":"student-onboarding-finalize.v1","expected_draft_version":1,"expected_profile_version":1}` + strings.Repeat(" ", 2<<10), requestID: teacherOnboardingRequestID},
	}
	for _, testCase := range tests {
		t.Run(testCase.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			response := performTeacherOnboardingRequest(router, testCase.method, testCase.target, testCase.body, testCase.requestID, teacherOnboardingToken)
			if response.Code != http.StatusBadRequest {
				t.Fatalf("status=%d body=%s", response.Code, response.Body.String())
			}
		})
	}
	if len(repo.replaceCommands) != 0 || len(repo.finalizeCommands) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("invalid requests reached repository: replace=%+v finalize=%+v", repo.replaceCommands, repo.finalizeCommands)
	}

	disabled := NewRouter(handler, "general-token", "planner-token", "")
	disabledResponse := performTeacherOnboardingRequest(disabled, http.MethodGet, path, "", "", "general-token")
	if disabledResponse.Code != http.StatusNotFound {
		t.Fatalf("unset Teacher token must leave route disabled: status=%d body=%s", disabledResponse.Code, disabledResponse.Body.String())
	}
}

func TestTeacherOnboardingCompletedGETRedactsAnswers(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 4, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	repo := teacherOnboardingRepository(t, now)
	completedVersion := repo.profile.Version
	repo.draft = domain.StudentOnboardingDraft{
		Schema: domain.StudentOnboardingDraftSchema, StudentID: teacherOnboardingStudentID,
		Status: domain.StudentOnboardingDraftStatusCompleted, Version: 2,
		CompletedProfileVersion: &completedVersion, CreatedAt: &now, UpdatedAt: &now, CompletedAt: &now,
	}
	router := NewRouter(teacherOnboardingInternalHandler(repo, now), "general-token", "planner-token", teacherOnboardingToken)
	path := "/v1/teacher/students/" + teacherOnboardingStudentID + "/onboarding/draft"
	response := performTeacherOnboardingRequest(router, http.MethodGet, path, "", "", teacherOnboardingToken)
	if response.Code != http.StatusOK || !strings.Contains(response.Body.String(), `"status":"COMPLETED"`) {
		t.Fatalf("completed state status=%d body=%s", response.Code, response.Body.String())
	}
	for _, answer := range []string{"direction_code", "self_assessed_experience", "known_stacks", "desired_stacks", "goal_code", "goal_text", "preferred_language", "weekly_minutes", "preferred_pace"} {
		if strings.Contains(response.Body.String(), answer) {
			t.Fatalf("completed GET leaked answer %q: %s", answer, response.Body.String())
		}
	}
}

func teacherOnboardingRepository(t *testing.T, now time.Time) *teacherOnboardingRepositoryStub {
	t.Helper()
	draft, err := domain.NormalizeStudentOnboardingDraft(domain.StudentOnboardingDraft{
		Schema: domain.StudentOnboardingDraftSchema, StudentID: teacherOnboardingStudentID,
		Status: domain.StudentOnboardingDraftStatusDraft, Version: 1, CreatedAt: &now, UpdatedAt: &now,
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	profile, err := domain.NormalizeStudentOnboarding(domain.StudentOnboarding{
		StudentID: teacherOnboardingStudentID, DirectionCode: "backend", SelfAssessedExperience: "basic",
		KnownStacks: []string{}, DesiredStacks: []string{"go"}, GoalCode: "first-job",
		PreferredLanguage: "ru", WeeklyMinutes: 300, PreferredPace: "balanced",
		Version: 1, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now,
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	completedVersion := profile.Version
	finalized, err := domain.NormalizeStudentOnboardingFinalizeResult(domain.StudentOnboardingFinalizeResult{
		Schema: domain.StudentOnboardingFinalizeResultSchema,
		Draft: domain.StudentOnboardingDraft{
			Schema: domain.StudentOnboardingDraftSchema, StudentID: teacherOnboardingStudentID,
			Status: domain.StudentOnboardingDraftStatusCompleted, Version: 2,
			CompletedProfileVersion: &completedVersion, CreatedAt: &now, UpdatedAt: &now, CompletedAt: &now,
		},
		Profile: profile,
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return &teacherOnboardingRepositoryStub{draft: draft, profile: profile, finalized: finalized}
}

func teacherOnboardingInternalHandler(repo *teacherOnboardingRepositoryStub, now time.Time) *Handler {
	return &Handler{
		OnboardingDrafts:       studentuc.GetStudentOnboardingDraft{Drafts: repo},
		OnboardingDraftWrites:  studentuc.PutStudentOnboardingDraft{Drafts: repo, Clock: teacherOnboardingClock{now: now}},
		OnboardingFinalization: studentuc.FinalizeStudentOnboardingDraft{Drafts: repo, Clock: teacherOnboardingClock{now: now}},
		OnboardingProfiles:     studentuc.GetStudentOnboarding{Profiles: repo},
	}
}

func publicOnboardingDraftRouter(repo *teacherOnboardingRepositoryStub, now time.Time) http.Handler {
	handler := &handlers.StudentOnboardingHandler{
		GetDraft:      studentuc.GetStudentOnboardingDraft{Drafts: repo},
		PutDraft:      studentuc.PutStudentOnboardingDraft{Drafts: repo, Clock: teacherOnboardingClock{now: now}},
		FinalizeDraft: studentuc.FinalizeStudentOnboardingDraft{Drafts: repo, Clock: teacherOnboardingClock{now: now}},
	}
	router := chi.NewRouter()
	router.Use(middleware.AuthMiddleware{}.Middleware)
	router.Use(middleware.RequireRole("STUDENT", "STUDENT_PRO"))
	router.Get("/student/onboarding/draft", handler.GetDraftProfile)
	router.Put("/student/onboarding/draft", handler.PutDraftProfile)
	router.Post("/student/onboarding/draft/finalize", handler.FinalizeDraftProfile)
	return router
}

func performTeacherOnboardingRequest(
	router http.Handler,
	method, path, body, requestID, token string,
) *httptest.ResponseRecorder {
	request := httptest.NewRequest(method, path, strings.NewReader(body))
	request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", token)
	if requestID != "" {
		request.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", requestID)
	}
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
	return response
}

func performPublicOnboardingRequest(
	router http.Handler,
	method, path, body, requestID string,
) *httptest.ResponseRecorder {
	request := httptest.NewRequest(method, path, strings.NewReader(body))
	request.Header.Set("X-User-ID", teacherOnboardingStudentID)
	request.Header.Set("X-User-Role", "STUDENT")
	request.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", requestID)
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
	return response
}
